svg.title: FFX VR controls: chords and gestures
svg.desc: Cards showing each chord and gesture FFX VR adds, with the controller parts to use highlighted.
svg.text: FFX VR controls: chords and gestures the mod adds
The highlighted parts are the ones to use. Chords never reach the game. Hold the grip first, then press.
First person, third person, diorama, in turn.
In a first-person battle: look through the next
Third person and the diorama: the view back
Left grip, then the menu button
Hold the grip for a moment first. The button
Let go within 0.3 s, hand still. Left: switch
characters. Right: one row back in the turn
order. Also in the seat and diorama views.
Seat and diorama views. One hand moves the
world; two hands also turn, tilt and scale it. In
third person two hands set the follow
First person in the field, with VR hands:
squeeze, then push about a hand's width
(10 cm) toward what you face. It presses
confirm: talk, examine, open. Either hand.
Grip squeeze at a labelled sphere
Cloister of Trials (Djose only so far), first
person, VR hands: reach until the label shows
closer": move nearer first. Either hand.
Either hand points at the panel in the room.
Squeeze a grip on it to move it; both grips to
resize it. While a hand points at the panel its
trigger and stick do not reach the game.
Lulu's Fury: draw circles. Auron's Bushido
("strike the targets", on by default; F8 >
Overdrives): cut each target along its arrow.
Leave these alone: they belong to Virtual Desktop or Fahrenheit
• Both stick clicks together: Virtual Desktop's own overlay (the mod keeps both clicks away from the game).
• A long press or a double tap of the left menu button: Virtual Desktop's own menu.
• Both grips + the menu button: Fahrenheit's soft reset (a game over in battle) if "and in every mod menu (Start and Back too)" is ticked.
